FishTable格式（CSV追加，每行一个list）：
[FishId, FishName, ScientificName, Category, Family, Rarity, MinLength_cm, MaxLength_cm, MinWeight_kg, MaxWeight_kg, HabitatLayer, ActiveTime, PreferredBait, FightPower, BasePrice_Gold, ExpReward, BaseMutationRate, Description]

- MinWeight = a * MinLength^b, MaxWeight = a * MaxLength^b，鲤科b≈3.0，其他≈2.95-3.1

- Rarity 1-10，FightPower 1-10，BasePrice和ExpReward与Rarity正相关

- Description约30-60字中文，包含样貌、习性
